rows.title: Unable to select Interpreter because special characters in the windows username.
rows.proposedComment: Thanks for the report and the concrete Windows trace. This is covered by https://github.com/microsoft/vscode-python/issues/24126, which tracks shell-aware escaping for generated Python commands. This report adds an important cmd.exe case: the interpreter-validation command consumes the carets in `C:\Users\^_^\...`, changing the path to `C:\Users\_\...`; that detail should be retained with the canonical issue as the work is consolidated there.
rows.verifyEvidence: B scopes itself to non-Windows shells mis-quoting paths with double quotes; A is Windows cmd stripping carets from unquoted interpreter-script arguments — a different platform and escaping defect, so closing A loses the Windows case.
